entries.german:
Gewerbliche Ausstellungen, Bd. 3

entries.english:
Commercial exhibitions, vol. 3

Includes: painters' trade and arts-and-crafts exhibition in Dortmund, 1905; German arts-and-crafts exhibition in Dresden, 1906; general German geodetic and cultural-engineering exhibition in Königsberg, participation of the State Archives, prospectus (printed), 1906; German National Art Exhibition in Düsseldorf, 1906; provincial exhibition for the hotel and restaurant trade in Dortmund (prospectus), 1907; exhibition of ornamental ironwork in Lüdenscheid, report on the exhibition, 1907; trade exhibition of the Rhine-Westphalian Innkeepers' Association in Düsseldorf, prospectus, 1908; trade exhibition for the Olpe district in Attendorn (printed matter), 1907; trade exhibition of the German Association of Druggists in Bochum, 1908; grants for visiting the “Munich 1908” exhibition; provincial exhibition for the hotel and restaurant trade in Bielefeld, 1908; exhibition for the baking trade in Bielefeld, 1908; Westphalian Craftsman’s Friend, 31 October 1908; exhibition of handicraft products in Coesfeld, 1909; exhibition of student work from the arts-and-crafts schools in Düsseldorf, 1910; trade exhibition in Hagen, 1910; international town-planning exhibition in Düsseldorf, prospectus, 1910; trade, industrial, and art exhibition in Herford: Illustrated Exhibition Papers, 1910; first Westphalian national hairdressing competition and trade exhibition in Hagen, prospectus, 1911; exhibition for the building trade and housing, 1911; patriotic jubilee exhibition in Breslau, 1912; travelling exhibition of the German Museum for Art in Trade and Industry in Hagen in the United States, 1912; The Newark Museum (prospectus), 1912; trade, industrial, and art exhibition in Paderborn, statutes (printed), 1913; Polish trade exhibition in Bochum, 1913; planned international exhibition for the book trade and graphic arts in Leipzig and exhibition of applied arts in Cologne for 1914; exhibition of the mastheads of Prussian official and district gazettes, 1913; international building exhibition in Leipzig, 1913; jubilee trade exhibition in Hagen (printed matter), 1913–1914; statutes of the trade association (printed), official exhibition map; exhibition of the jewelry collection of Privy Councillor Prof. Rosenberg in Karlsruhe at the Museum of Art and Industry in Dortmund, guide to the exhibition (printed), 1913; centenary exhibition in Dortmund, 1913; trade, art, and industrial exhibition in Minden, 1913; Westphalia Day at the German Werkbund exhibition in Cologne, 1914; complaint by the Werkenthin-Wand Company about the management of the trade, industrial, and art exhibition in Minden, 1914; technical operations exhibition of the War Ministry in Berlin, 1918; German trade fair in Munich; exhibition of the Gladbeck Crafts Office, 1921; trade fair in Münster, 1922; trade exhibition in Recklinghausen (prospectus), 1922; “Heat” exhibition in Essen, 1922; furniture fair in Detmold, 1922; opening of the first Cologne trade fair (invitation with Adenauer’s signature), 1924; invitation to the Cologne autumn fair, prospectus, 1924; Rhine-Westphalian food and luxury-food exhibition in Essen, 1925; invitation to the Cologne spring fair, prospectus and programme (printed), 1925; provincial culinary arts, trade, and commercial exhibition in Gelsenkirchen, 1925; exhibition for the reconstruction of the Ruhr region and the entire mining and iron-and-steel industry in Herne: 1925; resignation by the mayor as chair of the honorary committee, 1925; “Young Handicrafts” exhibition in Hagen, 1925; fifth Provincial Culinary Arts, Trade, and Commercial Exhibition in Gelsenkirchen: festival programme (printed); Ago arts-and-crafts exhibition for footwear in Aachen; invitations to the congress of the Westphalian-Lippe Craftsmen's Association, 1925; Westphalian-Lippe crafts and trade exhibition in Dortmund, 1925; crafts and trade exhibition of the Höxter district, 1925; invitations to events of the German Society for Industrial Hygiene in Essen, 1925.
